grh_a23f264513ccd8c0dcfd.title: Raffles
paragraphs: Gentleman thief A.J. Raffles wants to abandon crime for Gwen, but old friend Bunny's desperate financial trouble pulls him into one final burglary. At Lord Melrose's house Raffles plans to steal a valuable emerald necklace, only to find another burglar already in Lady Melrose's room. Raffles overpowers the intruder and takes the jewels himself, then repeatedly outmaneuvers Inspector Mackenzie while Gwen realizes the truth about the man she loves. When Scotland Yard finally identifies Raffles as the amateur cracksman, he admits it, returns the emeralds and directs Lord Melrose's promised reward to Bunny. Raffles escapes before arrest, but risks one last visit to Gwen to tell her he loves her before disappearing through the window.
